items.note: Russian ballistic missiles hit Darnytska CHPP-4 overnight on 13–14 October. Remaining generation at the plant has not been published.

A missile hit a nine-storey Desnyanskyi residence on Tuesday night, killing at least two people and injuring 21. Glavnoe reported the death toll from the Russian attack on Kyiv has risen to five, with another 36 injured.
The first Hamburg sitting ran just over two hours. The next hearing is 27 October.
Twelve senators on Tuesday told the President to rescind General License No. 135. No White House reply has been published.
